_what: What contracts 110.13.0-135.2.0 moved in the metric roster, measured 2026-10-26 by the re-extraction at 135.2.0 (226 metrics; refresh_metric_contracts.py reported retired [] and 226 written). The 35 v135.1 keys and PERP_SPOT_GAP are documented by the vendor changelog (battlegrid-mcp README 'Contract history - v135.1' / 'v134'); the other seven by 'Contract history - v123' (OMEGA v0.8.3 applied that contract's header renames, not its additions); details are the served hints. Nothing is retired.

UTC_HOUR.gloss: the hour of the UTC day the bar opened in, 0 to 23 — a fact of the bar's open time, never of when it is read

DAY_OF_WEEK.gloss: the UTC weekday the bar opened on, as the index 0 = Sunday, 1 = Monday, 2 = Tuesday, 3 = Wednesday, 4 = Thursday, 5 = Friday, 6 = Saturday — a fact of the bar's open time; a weekend is DAY_OF_WEEK outside 1 to 5

TRADING_SESSION.gloss: the trading session the bar opened in, fixed in UTC with no daylight-saving rule: asia (Asia 00–08 UTC), london (London 08–13 UTC), newYork (New York 13–21 UTC), late (Late 21–24 UTC) — a fact of the bar's open time

CLOSE_LOCATION.source: README v123 ('Seven metric keys are added'; OMEGA v0.8.3 took v123's header renames only)
CLOSE_LOCATION.gloss: where the bar closed within its own range, (close − low) / (high − low) — 0 at the low, 1 at the high; no value on a bar whose high equals its low

EMA8.source: README v123 ('Seven metric keys are added'; OMEGA v0.8.3 took v123's header renames only)

ASIA_HIGH.gloss: the highest price of the current Asia 00–08 UTC trading session so far (00:00–08:00 UTC) — a point-in-time read at its own fold, absent outside that trading session

ASIA_LOW.gloss: the lowest price of the current Asia 00–08 UTC trading session so far (00:00–08:00 UTC) — a point-in-time read at its own fold, absent outside that trading session

ASIA_OPEN.gloss: the opening print of the current Asia 00–08 UTC trading session (00:00–08:00 UTC) — a point-in-time read at its own fold, absent outside that trading session

PRIOR_ASIA_HIGH.gloss: the high of the previous completed Asia 00–08 UTC trading session (00:00–08:00 UTC), absent when that instance has no completed fold — never an older one

PRIOR_ASIA_LOW.gloss: the low of the previous completed Asia 00–08 UTC trading session (00:00–08:00 UTC), absent when that instance has no completed fold — never an older one

PRIOR_ASIA_OPEN.gloss: the opening print of the previous completed Asia 00–08 UTC trading session (00:00–08:00 UTC), absent when that instance has no completed fold — never an older one

PRIOR_ASIA_HIGH_SWEPT.gloss: whether any price since the previous Asia 00–08 UTC trading session closed has traded strictly above its high: swept, else intact — a touch is not a sweep; read live, because the last price decides; absent while that instance, any trading session since it, or the current one has no fold, or the last price is unknown

PRIOR_ASIA_LOW_SWEPT.gloss: whether any price since the previous Asia 00–08 UTC trading session closed has traded strictly below its low: swept, else intact — a touch is not a sweep; read live, because the last price decides; absent while that instance, any trading session since it, or the current one has no fold, or the last price is unknown

LONDON_HIGH.gloss: the highest price of the current London 08–13 UTC trading session so far (08:00–13:00 UTC) — a point-in-time read at its own fold, absent outside that trading session

LONDON_LOW.gloss: the lowest price of the current London 08–13 UTC trading session so far (08:00–13:00 UTC) — a point-in-time read at its own fold, absent outside that trading session

LONDON_OPEN.gloss: the opening print of the current London 08–13 UTC trading session (08:00–13:00 UTC) — a point-in-time read at its own fold, absent outside that trading session

PRIOR_LONDON_HIGH.gloss: the high of the previous completed London 08–13 UTC trading session (08:00–13:00 UTC), absent when that instance has no completed fold — never an older one

PRIOR_LONDON_LOW.gloss: the low of the previous completed London 08–13 UTC trading session (08:00–13:00 UTC), absent when that instance has no completed fold — never an older one

PRIOR_LONDON_OPEN.gloss: the opening print of the previous completed London 08–13 UTC trading session (08:00–13:00 UTC), absent when that instance has no completed fold — never an older one

PRIOR_LONDON_HIGH_SWEPT.gloss: whether any price since the previous London 08–13 UTC trading session closed has traded strictly above its high: swept, else intact — a touch is not a sweep; read live, because the last price decides; absent while that instance, any trading session since it, or the current one has no fold, or the last price is unknown

PRIOR_LONDON_LOW_SWEPT.gloss: whether any price since the previous London 08–13 UTC trading session closed has traded strictly below its low: swept, else intact — a touch is not a sweep; read live, because the last price decides; absent while that instance, any trading session since it, or the current one has no fold, or the last price is unknown

NEW_YORK_HIGH.gloss: the highest price of the current New York 13–21 UTC trading session so far (13:00–21:00 UTC) — a point-in-time read at its own fold, absent outside that trading session

NEW_YORK_LOW.gloss: the lowest price of the current New York 13–21 UTC trading session so far (13:00–21:00 UTC) — a point-in-time read at its own fold, absent outside that trading session

NEW_YORK_OPEN.gloss: the opening print of the current New York 13–21 UTC trading session (13:00–21:00 UTC) — a point-in-time read at its own fold, absent outside that trading session

PRIOR_NEW_YORK_HIGH.gloss: the high of the previous completed New York 13–21 UTC trading session (13:00–21:00 UTC), absent when that instance has no completed fold — never an older one

PRIOR_NEW_YORK_LOW.gloss: the low of the previous completed New York 13–21 UTC trading session (13:00–21:00 UTC), absent when that instance has no completed fold — never an older one

PRIOR_NEW_YORK_OPEN.gloss: the opening print of the previous completed New York 13–21 UTC trading session (13:00–21:00 UTC), absent when that instance has no completed fold — never an older one

PRIOR_NEW_YORK_HIGH_SWEPT.gloss: whether any price since the previous New York 13–21 UTC trading session closed has traded strictly above its high: swept, else intact — a touch is not a sweep; read live, because the last price decides; absent while that instance, any trading session since it, or the current one has no fold, or the last price is unknown

PRIOR_NEW_YORK_LOW_SWEPT.gloss: whether any price since the previous New York 13–21 UTC trading session closed has traded strictly below its low: swept, else intact — a touch is not a sweep; read live, because the last price decides; absent while that instance, any trading session since it, or the current one has no fold, or the last price is unknown

OR15_HIGH.gloss: the highest price of the current UTC day's first 15 minutes — a point-in-time read at its own fold, absent until that range closes

OR15_LOW.gloss: the lowest price of the current UTC day's first 15 minutes — a point-in-time read at its own fold, absent until that range closes

OR30_HIGH.gloss: the highest price of the current UTC day's first 30 minutes — a point-in-time read at its own fold, absent until that range closes

OR30_LOW.gloss: the lowest price of the current UTC day's first 30 minutes — a point-in-time read at its own fold, absent until that range closes

IB_EXT_UP_150.gloss: the current UTC day's initial-balance high plus 0.5 × its range (IB high − IB low), where the day's range from the IB low reaches 1.5× the initial balance, derived from the initial balance of the first 60 minutes — a point-in-time read at its own fold, absent until the initial balance closes or when it has no range

IB_EXT_DOWN_150.gloss: the current UTC day's initial-balance low minus 0.5 × its range (IB high − IB low), where the day's range from the IB high reaches 1.5× the initial balance, derived from the initial balance of the first 60 minutes — a point-in-time read at its own fold, absent until the initial balance closes or when it has no range

IB_EXT_UP_200.gloss: the current UTC day's initial-balance high plus 1 × its range (IB high − IB low), where the day's range from the IB low reaches 2× the initial balance, derived from the initial balance of the first 60 minutes — a point-in-time read at its own fold, absent until the initial balance closes or when it has no range

IB_EXT_DOWN_200.gloss: the current UTC day's initial-balance low minus 1 × its range (IB high − IB low), where the day's range from the IB high reaches 2× the initial balance, derived from the initial balance of the first 60 minutes — a point-in-time read at its own fold, absent until the initial balance closes or when it has no range

PRIOR_SWING_FRACTAL_HIGH.source: README v123 ('Seven metric keys are added'; OMEGA v0.8.3 took v123's header renames only)
PRIOR_SWING_FRACTAL_HIGH.gloss: the high of the decided swing high before the most recent one, while it is in reach — the pivot the structure label compares a swing high with

PRIOR_SWING_FRACTAL_LOW.source: README v123 ('Seven metric keys are added'; OMEGA v0.8.3 took v123's header renames only)
PRIOR_SWING_FRACTAL_LOW.gloss: the low of the decided swing low before the most recent one, while it is in reach — the pivot the structure label compares a swing low with

SWING_FRACTAL_HIGH_BARS_AGO.source: README v123 ('Seven metric keys are added'; OMEGA v0.8.3 took v123's header renames only)
SWING_FRACTAL_HIGH_BARS_AGO.gloss: the bars from the most recent swing high's own bar to this bar — 2 on the bar that completes its right side, one more per bar after it

SWING_FRACTAL_LOW_BARS_AGO.source: README v123 ('Seven metric keys are added'; OMEGA v0.8.3 took v123's header renames only)
SWING_FRACTAL_LOW_BARS_AGO.gloss: the bars from the most recent swing low's own bar to this bar — 2 on the bar that completes its right side, one more per bar after it

CMF20.source: README v123 ('Seven metric keys are added'; OMEGA v0.8.3 took v123's header renames only)
CMF20.gloss: 20-period Chaikin money flow — each bar's volume weighted by where it closed in its range (−1 at the low, +1 at the high, 0 on a flat bar), summed over the 20 bars ending at this bar and divided by their volume; no value when that volume is zero

PERP_SPOT_GAP.gloss: gap between the bounded self-normalized spot and perp CVD rates, |spot rate − perp rate| (0–2), compared unrounded; no value on the bar after the UTC-day reset or where the composite spot tape is unavailable (crypto coins a spot venue lists)

includeMtfConfluence.replacement: custom columns MA_ALIGN x value, RSI14 x classifyZone, ADX x classifyZone at {rel: lower} (headers MAalign_ltf, RSI14_ltf_zone, ADX14_ltf_zone, rendered 2026-10-26)
